interventions.detail: Used Python 3.11 via uv because torchaudio<2.1 has no Python 3.12 wheels
Installed CPU torch==2.0.1 / torchaudio==2.0.2 from the PyTorch CPU index
Installed setuptools<81 because torch 2.0 imports pkg_resources
apt installed ffmpeg (mp3 decoding) and libsndfile1 + pip soundfile (torchaudio wav writing backend)
Ran the weight pre-download from /tmp so /work/demucs isn't picked up as a namespace package
